Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: realistic ZOMBIE HORROR WALL DECAL ATLAS, an expansion set for distressed abandoned hospital / industrial building interiors.
Generate landscape 4K 3840 x 2160 pixels if supported, maximum photographic microdetail. TRUE transparent RGBA background with clean irregular alpha edges, fine semitransparent edges where appropriate. Exactly EIGHT separate decals arranged in a strict 4-column by 2-row grid, in reading order. Each mark fully inside central 65% of its cell; generous EMPTY transparent outer margins and gutters. No clipping, overlap or stray flecks in neighbouring cells.

Only the damage/stain/deposit itself, no complete wall, rectangular backing panel or environment. Transparent gaps between separate features, no opaque white halo, no pale wall painted behind stains. No actual hands, people, faces, body parts, organs or wounds. No floor, objects, text, logos, watermark, grid, visible checkerboard or borders. Realistic gritty horror art direction, no cartoon or stylization.
